name: Korea travel access
description: Korea travel access: reach maps, stations, best spots and a timeline.

meta.note: Travel-ease / area-centrality / best-spots proxy scores over the 471-station Seoul subway graph, plus national KTX/SRT rail, 41 web-verified Aug-Oct 2026 events (genre-classified), a network-routed walk-access-to-nearest-station heatmap (fine+coarse grid, real OSM footpaths, now joined to its nearest station for reach-explorer use), a Reach Explorer screen (8 curated origin hubs x subway/subway+rail mode x time-budget slider, cool-to-red sequential recolor, plus a true MapLibre kernel-density Heat mode alongside the discrete Buckets view — seoul-true-heat round), tap-to-justify detail on every colored map layer, meter-bar component scores on every numeric score column, and a Best-spots map view (bestspotsmap-0807): every best_spots row carries lat/lon, the area-weighted centroid of its own district polygon in seoul_districts.geojson (derived, no new fetch), so the shipped focusRow/goto camera-follow primitive can centre the map on a tapped ranked district. Built by tool/korea/build_krtravel.py + build_krtravel_assets.py + build_krtravel_content.py + build_hexwalk.py + build_reach_matrix.py + build_reach_walkjoin.py + build_reach_hubs.py + build_reach_heat_points.py. See DATA_SOURCES.md 'terrain krtravel' section for every formula and honesty caveat.
